description.text: Curriculum: Small class size of 15-18 persons in the International Exchange College. Courses available include elementary, intermediate, and advanced classes in Spoken Chinese, Chinese Listening Comprehension, and Chinese Reading and Writing. Certificate will be issued after completion of the courses. Enrollment time: September 1st for Fall Semester.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Program at Jilin University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/per semester ￥ 8000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese,if not, it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicants must be at least 18 years old with a high school diploma or a college diploma.
